method: A fresh agent context received the corrected policy and only the current cutoff-boundary stimulus. The first reply was saved before the scripted second user turn was revealed. No rubric or prior responses were supplied.
limitations: One focused two-turn retest; the other seven cases were not rerun after this clarification.
Scripted fictional user; this is not evidence of human comprehension.

With your approved cutoff of 2, the choice changes whether measurements exactly equal to 2 contribute to the count. For measurements [1, 2, 3], including 2 keeps [2, 3] and counts two observations. Excluding 2 keeps only [3] and counts one observation.

Because the goal is to count observations that meet the cutoff, I recommend including measurements exactly equal to 2. This treats reaching the cutoff as sufficient. Should a measurement of exactly 2 count?
Understood. Measurements equal to 2 or above 2 will be kept and counted. Measurements below 2 will be excluded. The approved cutoff remains 2.
